body.name: Caughey comparator rank-score specification
body.construction: Fix a total order \(\prec\) before \(X\) is drawn, equivalently condition on a unit permutation sampled independently of \(X\). Let \(R_u(y)\) be the ascending rank of \(y_u\) among \(\{y_v:v\in U\}\), resolving every tie deterministically by \(\prec\). For any nondecreasing \(\phi\), set \(T_{\mathrm C}(x,y)=\sum_{u\in U}Z_u(x)\phi(R_u(y))\).
